architecture_findings.location: OrderService L938 (POS at-creation) + FrontendOrderService L1130-1153 (kiosk auto-allocate post-payment)
architecture_findings.observation: Two allocation entry points for two transaction lifecycles. POS allocates inside saveOrderWithQueueNumber savepoint (rollback-safe — failed transaction releases the seq number for next caller via MAX+1). Kiosk allocates in finalizePaidKioskOrder INSIDE the lockForUpdate transaction — failure persists fiscal_alloc_error_at marker and lets RetryFiscalAllocCommand cron pick it up every minute. Two paths, one SSOT (FiscalSequenceService::next).

Iter14 hardening: kiosk-paid orders whose fiscal alloc fails now write fiscal_alloc_error_at (no exception re-throw that would rollback payment), and the cron re-invokes the SAME finalize path (single SSOT). The aggregation at Z close warns operators about pending orphans via warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders (L586-616). Z aggregate excludes orphans correctly (NF525 gap-free invariant) — orphans cannot enter a Z report by accident.

Post-Z refund uses formal counter-entry mirror order (NEGATED total/subtotal/tax + items + payments, fresh fiscal_sequence_no, parent_order_id FK self-ref). SealedOrderGuard::assertSealed (L84-114) gates this path: only orders inside a CLOSED Z window can mirror. Pre-Z refund uses standard RETURNED transition (still mutable parent). One predicate, two enforcement paths — no semantic drift.

Iter15-P0-10 hardening: refund mirror order now duplicates parent's OrderPayment rows with negated amounts + terminal_id carry-forward (Sprint H2 P1-Z7-01 2026-05-17). Without this, split-payment Z reconciliation would be under-credited per payment method (only the aggregate Order.total was negated). Cross-branch admin tools call withoutGlobalScopes() correctly — payments still write to the parent's branch_id (preserves multi-tenant isolation).

summary: Fiscal cascade composition is exemplary — five invariants enforced via defense-in-depth at three layers (cache lock + transactional DB lock + UNIQUE index + DB triggers). Dual allocation paths (POS at-creation, kiosk auto-allocate on PAID) feed one SSOT (FiscalSequenceService::next). Post-Z refund uses formal counter-entry mirror with parent immutability. Orphan retry cron prevents silent NF525 gaps. No architectural concerns observed; no patches recommended. Recommendation: KEEP-AS-IS across all 14 fiscal-cascade files.
